text:
alex: FYI GreenLeaf (acct GL-998) says their procurement team will not accept any invoice unless we have a signed PO on file. They're blocking payment — need guidance on whether we can issue a provisional invoice or hold billing. cc @jenny-billing @paul_finance
jenny-billing: Do we have their legal billing name + VAT? Without PO we can't set net-30 terms. Also our billing UI doesn't have a 'pending PO' state, so ops would be manual.
paul_finance: Policy note — we only finalize invoices after order confirmation. We can produce a pro-forma statement for their records, but the official accounting invoice must reference a PO per their procurement. Manual issuance possible once PO arrives.
miguel_sales: Contract clause 4.2 references invoicing on usage, but customer insists on a PO pre-invoice. Sales can accept PO number and add to invoice metadata. Need confirmation from billing on how to surface PO on the final invoice.
tara_procurement: Can we add a PO number field in the invoice payload/UI? If not, manual process will be needed. @billing-bot is there an API param for po_number that our processor will respect?
billing-bot: Invoice API example: ```POST /v1/invoices { "customer_id": "GL-998", "period_start": "2026-02-01", "period_end": "2026-02-28", "po_number": "STRING" }``` Note: po_number currently gets included in the customer-facing email but is not exported to the GL CSV.
jenny-billing: That's the gap — our GL export doesn't include po_number, so finance mapping is manual. Manual invoice + attach PO to accounting record will take ~1 business day.
alex: GreenLeaf procurement also asked for vendor tax ID (EIN) + detailed line items (month usage) on the invoice. Can we generate that on demand?
paul_finance: Yes we can produce a line-itemized pro-forma showing usage and unit rates. Official invoice still requires PO per their rule. Recommended flow: 1) generate pro-forma/usage statement and send to customer, 2) wait for PO, 3) issue official invoice with PO number and close.
miguel_sales: I'll request their PO template and vendor form now. Please CC finance on any docs. Also confirm whether they require PO before invoicing or before payment.
tara_procurement: :thumbsup: I'll spin up a short JIRA to track adding po_number to the GL export and invoice metadata (priority: medium). If urgent, we can do a manual invoice this week.
jenny-billing: Can someone confirm VAT ID and billing address so I can prep the pro-forma? If they're EU and reverse-charge applies, we need VAT ID to zero-rate.
alex: Shared via DM — VAT ID GB999888777, billing address: 12 High St, London, SW1A 1AA.
paul_finance: Got it. I'll prepare the pro-forma and draft the manual invoice steps. Tagging @miguel_sales when ready so sales can attach PO when it arrives.
miguel_sales: Thanks. If PO delays > 7 days they may need a temporary credit hold — we'll decide then.
jenny-billing: Preparing email template for pro-forma now, will include usage lines and note that official invoice will follow once PO is received.
paul_finance: ETA for manual processing: end of next business day after PO receipt.
alex: Cool — I'll update the customer with this flow and ask them to send the PO + vendor form to billing@redwood.ai.
(reacts: :eyes: :white_check_mark:)
